question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

My life has ______ meaning without you
solution:
The correct answer is **No.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is **No**.
 
• Because We use **No** **before a noun phrase.**
 
• Thus
